purpose: Evidence ledger for GitHub AI and repository platform controls. Unknown or inaccessible settings are never inferred to be disabled or compliant.

controls.name: Copilot seat allocation and billing
controls.finding: GitHub announced upfront seat charging changes, but the connected repository integration cannot read seat rosters, inactive assignments, or payment state.

evidence.result: Billing-policy announcement reviewed; no organization seat data was available to the repository integration.

controls.next_action: Export aggregate assigned, active, inactive, and pending-cancellation seat counts for each organization; remove orphaned seats and record the evidence digest without committing user identities.

controls.name: Copilot model permissions
controls.finding: GitHub announced global model-policy enforcement as generally available; effective allow and deny policy for both organizations is not exposed by this integration.

evidence.result: Product announcement verified; effective organization policy remains unverified.

controls.next_action: Capture each organization's allowed model set, exception path, policy owner, and effective timestamp; test one permitted and one denied model from a managed seat.

controls.name: Copilot conversation retention
controls.finding: GitHub announced lifetime retention for web chat history. The actual workspace policy, deletion path, export path, and classification constraints require an admin review.

evidence.result: Retention change announcement reviewed; no account-level retention evidence was accessible.

controls.next_action: Document permitted data classes, deletion and export procedures, legal hold expectations, and whether durable chat history changes repository or client-data handling rules.

controls.name: Copilot code review default
controls.finding: GitHub announced a default change from Lite to Balanced review. Effective defaults and usage impact across managed repositories are not available through the repository integration.

evidence.result: Default-change announcement reviewed; repository and organization overrides remain unverified.

controls.next_action: Verify the effective review mode, sample cost and finding quality on ten representative pull requests, then record an explicit default and exception rule.

controls.name: Copilot spend budgets and alerts
controls.finding: Budgets, premium-request limits, alert recipients, and exception approvers are billing facts that the connected repository integration cannot access.

evidence.result: No prior version-controlled evidence record for AI spend controls was found in the governance repository.

controls.next_action: Record monthly budget, warning threshold, hard or soft limit, alert recipients, premium-request policy, and exception approver for each organization; store only aggregate values in this public ledger.

controls.name: Personal Copilot plan and billing
controls.finding: The personal installation is not an organization seat scope. Its plan, renewal state, and usage limits are account-owner facts unavailable to the repository integration.

evidence.result: 4444J99 classified as a user account, not an organization account.

controls.next_action: Account owner must record the personal Copilot plan, renewal state, usage limits, and whether personal billing is permitted for estate work.

controls.name: Personal Copilot model access
controls.finding: Organization model policy does not establish the personal account's effective model access or suitability for organization work.

evidence.result: 4444J99 classified as a user account with a separate policy boundary.

controls.next_action: Account owner must capture the effective personal model set and record which estate workloads, if any, may use the personal policy boundary.

controls.name: Personal Copilot conversation retention
controls.finding: GitHub announced lifetime web-chat history retention, but the personal account's effective deletion, export, and data-use boundary requires account-owner verification.

evidence.result: Retention announcement reviewed; personal account behavior remains unverified.

controls.next_action: Account owner must verify retention, export, and deletion behavior and prohibit client or restricted estate data until that boundary is documented.

controls.name: Personal Copilot code review default
controls.finding: GitHub announced a Balanced code-review default, but the effective personal default and its usage impact are not exposed to the repository integration.

evidence.result: Default-change announcement reviewed; personal account setting remains unverified.

controls.next_action: Account owner must verify the effective mode and keep personal review usage separate from organization cost and quality baselines.

controls.name: Personal Copilot spend boundary
controls.finding: Personal subscription charges and premium usage are outside organization budgets unless explicitly allocated and approved.

evidence.result: 4444J99 classified as a user account with a separate billing boundary.

controls.next_action: Account owner must record the permitted reimbursement or allocation rule, usage limit, and alert path, or mark personal AI spend as excluded from estate work.

controls.next_action: Organization owner must capture the effective ruleset view and confirm required checks, force-push protection, deletion protection, bypass actors, and scope.
